output.source_text: There are only 3 unique fully diminished 7th chord collections on the piano because they are built entirely of stacked minor 3rd intervals: C°7 (C-Eb-Gb-A), C#°7 (C#-E-G-Bb), and D°7 (D-F-Ab-B). Going up another half step to Eb°7 results in the same notes as C°7.

note_vi: Bài 40 của nguồn Jazz Scales (YouTube), mốc 00:46-01:56. There are only 3 unique fully diminished 7th chord collections on the piano because they are built entirely of stacked minor 3rd intervals: C°7 (C-Eb-Gb-A), C#°7 (C#-E-G-Bb), and D°7 (D-F-Ab-B). Going up another half step to Eb°7 results in the same notes as C°7. Nguồn giảng bằng tiếng Anh, câu trên giữ nguyên lời giảng. Item còn draft: chưa ai xem lại video để đối chiếu.
